about_the_game:
A child. Alone. But not without courage.

In Soly: Brave Little Explorer, you play as Soly, a 12-year-old boy lost in a dark and unsettling crypt. With no one to rely on, he must find the strength within himself to face his deepest fears and find a way out.

A rogue-lite of exploration and emotional survival

Each run throws you into a procedurally generated crypt, filled with creatures born from the child’s imagination—strange, sometimes absurd or terrifying enemies like vampires, zombies, and ghosts, shaped by his most primal childhood fears. Fight through auto-shooter combat, collect equipment and upgrade it to fit your playstyle. Before each run, create your build by selecting which gear to bring—every combination can change the course of your adventure.

A story about fear, courage… and inner light

More than just an action game, Soly is a personal journey through darkness. Guided by a small, mysterious robot, Soly must learn to confront his fears, one run at a time. Each exploration lets you unlock new mechanics and progress through an adventure focused on personal growth.

🎮 Key Features

  • Procedurally generated crypts every run

  • Fast-paced, evolving auto-shooter combat

  • Build system: choose your equipment before each run

  • Equipment to collect and upgrade during your journey

  • Polished pixel art and immersive retro atmosphere
